title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Teardown Tariff: Documenting Warranted Repair Zones
content:
**Rule.** An active network structural warranty on the vehicle adds a documentation add-on to a Repair Estimates & Appointments teardown charge, for photographing and inspecting the warranted repair zones. The add-on is read from the vehicle's Workmanship Warranties coverage in active status and its plan:

| Active Workmanship Warranties plan on the vehicle | Documentation add-on |
|---|---|
| Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 120.00 USD |
| Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 60.00 USD |
| No such active warranty | none |

An active Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty adds 120.00 USD, an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty adds 60.00 USD, and no such active warranty adds none.

Points of judgement (hypothetical vehicles):

- A Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty on the vehicle that has expired is not active: none.
- An active Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty is not one of the two plans: none.
- An active Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty: 120.00 USD.
